hoaxes.title: Meta will plant one tree for every question users ask its AI assistant
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Ars Technica reports Meta is rethinking its 2030 net-zero goal after emissions rose about 40% in a year.

hoaxes.title: Netflix's Cliff Booth IMAX screenings will pause halfway so viewers can check their phones
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth plays in IMAX for two weeks from November 25 before Netflix on December 23.

hoaxes.title: Switch 2 Black Friday bundle comes with a real steering wheel that clips onto the console
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Amazon and Walmart are selling the Switch 2 with Mario Kart World for $499, $50 off its $549 price.

hoaxes.title: Apple's iPhone Air 2 is said to come with a free case that makes it as thick as an iPhone 18
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Dummy units said to show the iPhone Air 2 point to a new dual rear camera; Apple has announced nothing.
